title: Audit sampling, SSO alert gaps, and admin playbook follow-up
creator: Priya Shah
description: Follow-up actions from the auth/audit incident on 2026-03-05. We observed that high-volume, low-risk API traffic caused audit ingest backpressure which delayed admin event indexing and muted SSO/SAML alerting. This ticket coordinates: 1) a safe sampling plan that preserves high-fidelity admin and RBAC-change events while reducing overall ingest volume, 2) adjustments to SSO/SAML alert thresholds and a new dashboard to detect assertion/validation failures, 3) a polished admin incident playbook and runbook for on-call, and 4) minor runtime instrumentation changes to ensure audit exporter retries are visible in tracing.
acceptance_criteria: Sampling policy implemented: 100% for admin/RBAC-change events, 25% for auth error events, 10% for routine token-refresh events
Dashboard created: 'Auth Audit Health' with panels for ingest lag, dropped-audit-rates, SAML assertion failures, and admin-op latency
SLOs updated: audit-log ingestion 99th percentile <= 3s for admin events, 99.9% delivery success to audit store
Alerts tuned: reduced false positives from token refresh spikes; new alert for >1% drop in admin event indexing over 5m
Runbook published and linked; on-call validated steps and escalations documented
Telemetry changes merged and deployed (trace spans for audit-export send/retry, tags for sampling-rate), unit/integration tests added
